top_needs.title: Practice efficiency gains and ROI with DM-monitored braces and aligners versus standard recall
top_needs.brands_and_products: Damon, Ormco, Spark, Angel, Invisalign, ClearCorrect, Suresmile, KLOwen, Lightforce, SmartSTL, self-ligating braces, twin brackets, damon ultima brackets, SLB, ScanBox
top_needs.metrics_sought: chair time reduction, appointment frequency, ROI, profitability, time saving, visit reduction, rentability, ongoing monitoring costs vs benefits, adaptive aligner change, average visit reduction, efficiency in second and third order movements, decrease of emergencies, performance in NHS Hospital environment
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors are skeptical that DM will actually save them time or money, or that it will reduce the number of in-person appointments. They question whether the investment in DM will pay off in terms of efficiency, profitability, or staff workload, especially for braces cases.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, case study, peer-reviewed, white paper, only German studies, only Australian studies, just European sources, recent studies, clinical report, clinical cases
sample_queries: How much chair time reduction achieved
How can I make DM work in a practice with 8 chairs and 15 assistants in a way that they really get the real benefits and make it work financially as well in The Netherlands?
Evidence that DM reduces number of visits for braces cases
Could you provide any data demonstrating improved patient compliance with DM or its impact on patient outcomes
Are Damon brackets more efficient than other brands?
top_needs.gap_assessment: There is a need for robust, region-specific ROI and efficiency data, especially for non-aligner appliances and in diverse practice settings. Comparative studies with clear financial outcomes should be prioritized.

top_needs.title: Accuracy and reliability of DM’s AI and SmartSTL for clinical monitoring and diagnostics
top_needs.metrics_sought: AI accuracy, specificity and sensitivity, reliability, accuracy of SmartSTL, accuracy of scanning, occlusal assessment, class I goal, FDA class I, AI versus orthodontist, accuracy of AI detecting eruption, accuracy of AI reports vs human specialists
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors express distrust in the AI’s ability to detect clinical issues accurately, fearing misdiagnosis or missed problems. Some are concerned about the reliability of SmartSTL compared to intraoral scans or human assessment.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, clinical study, white paper, peer-reviewed, only academic publication, only German studies
sample_queries: Information on the accuracy of DM, a patient has questioned the ability of the AI to detect clinical observations

Occlusal Assessment: A quantitative study validating the AI’s accuracy in detecting malocclusions (midline deviation, overbite, overjet, and canine relationship) found that the mean bias across all parameters was less than 0.5 mm, confirming its reliability as a remote diagnosis and triage tool.
Looking for white papers on Smart STL accuracy to help convince a doctor to use it in the practice.
How accurate is DentalMonitorings AI and will it save me money
How accurate is SmartSTL compared to intraoral scan and anything on monitoring+
top_needs.gap_assessment: Direct head-to-head studies comparing DM AI/SmartSTL to gold-standard clinical assessments and intraoral scans are limited. More peer-reviewed, quantitative validation studies are needed.

top_needs.title: Patient experience, satisfaction, and compliance with DM-monitored orthodontic treatment
top_needs.metrics_sought: patient experience, patient satisfaction, patient perception, patient engagement, compliance, time spent on app, staff satisfaction, practice differentiation
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors are unsure if patients will actually like or comply with DM monitoring, or if it will improve their experience. Some question whether DM will differentiate their practice or improve staff morale.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, case study, peer-reviewed, insights, only academic publication
sample_queries: Is there any evidence on how much patients like DentalMonitoring
Patient experience and satisfaction from DM use
what is the stats on staff satisfaction using dm
I want to see evidence that shows DM results in improved compliance in wearing aligners
Patient scanning and compliance
top_needs.gap_assessment: More quantitative and qualitative studies on patient and staff satisfaction, compliance rates, and practice differentiation are needed, especially for non-aligner cases.

top_needs.title: Clinical impact of DM on treatment outcomes: duration, refinements, and case quality for aligners and braces
top_needs.brands_and_products: Spark, Angel, Invisalign, ClearCorrect, Suresmile, SmartSTL, Damon, Lightforce
top_needs.metrics_sought: treatment duration, number of refinements, nontracking aligners, unfinished aligner sets, fitting and tracking quality, passivity archwires, debond rates, bonding failures, door breakage, torque efficiency, elastic compliance, clinical outcomes, before-and-after prediction
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors are skeptical that DM monitoring will actually improve clinical outcomes, reduce refinements, or shorten treatment time. They want proof that DM leads to better or faster results compared to standard care.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, clinical report, retrospective cohort study, case study, white paper
sample_queries: I am looking for fitting and tacking quality between different aligner brands. Specifically Spark, Angel, Invisalign, clearcorrect and suresmile
Outcomes of clear aligner treatment with and without Dental Monitoring: A retrospective cohort study
I have a doctor looking for evidence showing that DM has reduced the number of refinements needed for patients.
Do we have a study on passivity archwires?
Looking for efficiency in different bracket systems, bonding failures and door breakage in different brands SL brackets
top_needs.gap_assessment: Comparative outcome data for DM-monitored versus non-monitored cases, especially for braces and specific aligner brands, is sparse. More controlled studies on refinements and treatment duration are needed.

top_needs.title: Integration of DM into practice workflow: staff roles, scheduling, and multi-location management
top_needs.metrics_sought: workflow improvement, staff efficiency, diary changes, staff satisfaction, dynamic scheduling, multi-location practice, external collaborators, practice optimization, practice differentiation
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors and staff are concerned about the complexity of integrating DM into existing workflows, potential additional workload, and whether staff will comply or benefit. Multi-location practices worry about consistency and financial viability.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: No format preference specified — reps asked for any available evidence
sample_queries: Explain to that prospect what integrating DM means concretely for them and their team
How can I make DM work in a practice with 8 chairs and 15 assistants in a way that they really get the real benefits and make it work financially as well in The Netherlands?
multi location practice and doctor is considering quitting DM
staff not compliant with using DM
how to implement DM with external collaborators; pricing for Observation monitoring to families
top_needs.gap_assessment: Practical, step-by-step workflow integration guides and real-world case studies for large or multi-site practices are lacking. Evidence on staff adoption and satisfaction should be expanded.

top_needs.title: Retention monitoring and value-add for post-treatment patients using DM
top_needs.metrics_sought: retention lapse percentage, retention optimization, value for retention, supervisor during retention, retention plans, retention side business expansion
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors question whether DM adds value during the retention phase, if it can prevent relapse, and whether it is worth the cost for post-treatment monitoring. Some are unsure how to monetize or expand retention services.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, case study, only academic publication

Is DM efficient for retention?
percentage lapse in retention

How retention can generate money but applicable to small french practice (600 patients)
top_needs.gap_assessment: There is limited published data on relapse rates, patient outcomes, and financial benefits of DM in retention. More studies and business case examples are needed.
